name: tofu-ads
description: Tofu Ads helps users create, revise, organize, and download branded LinkedIn single-image and carousel ads and Google Display image sets. It can build brand profiles from websites and saved assets, preserve creative version history, and manage standalone creatives without launching or modifying ad campaigns.

defaultPrompt: Create a LinkedIn ad for [website URL], using my website’s branding, colors, and messaging.
Turn [landing page URL] into a 5-card LinkedIn carousel highlighting the key benefits and a clear call to action.
Create Google Display banner ads for [website URL] in multiple sizes, with consistent branding and a ‘Book a demo’ CTA.
